decisions.title: Inventory quantity, components and shelf life
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: whole-unit demo: BloodUnit.quantity=1; request quantity positive integer whole units; no bag splitting; exact group/component match. Components RBC/PLASMA/PLATELETS. All supported component shelf-life days must be explicitly configured/approved; no clinical defaults.

decisions.title: Expiry and stock states
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: collection_date local Asia/Kolkata date, never future; expiry_date=collection_date+approved shelf_life_days. Usable only while local_date < expiry_date; equality is expired. AVAILABLE/ISSUED/DISCARDED/QUARANTINED stored states; EXPIRED derived in read projection. Stock sums only usable AVAILABLE quantities. No independent decrement counter.

decisions.title: Request lifecycle and provisioning
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: REQUESTER accounts seeded/provisioned by restricted management command, never public role assignment. Urgency CRITICAL/URGENT/ROUTINE ordered in that order then created_at/id. SUBMITTED→APPROVED/REJECTED; rejection reason required. Partial issue keeps APPROVED with fulfilled_quantity; exact completion→ISSUED; owning requester may close only ISSUED→CLOSED via dedicated action. No reopening or cancellation in this scope.

decisions.title: Operational staff and camp role matrix
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: active non-superuser STAFF for inventory/request review/issue; ADMIN only dashboard/reports; no clinical answers included. Camp create/cancel ADMIN only, update ADMIN or STAFF, slots ADMIN or STAFF; booking DONOR only. Clinical endpoints retain the existing explicit health permission. Do not reuse the clinical-staff gate for all operational staff by accident.

decisions.title: Slot and camp capacity/cancellation
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: aware start/end times; positive slot capacity; optional camp FK permits walk-ins; camp total capacity also enforced across its slots. Duplicate active donor/slot denied. Lock camp then slot (UUID order when multiple), then booking rows. Camp cancel cancels active appointments and durable cancellation intents atomically; no silent future bookings. Screening must be current ELIGIBLE before booking; no new medical rules.

decisions.title: Alerts and mocked delivery
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: configured near-expiry days and per group/component minimums; equality to minimum is NOT low stock; near expiry requires 0 < expiry_date-local_date <= configured days. No invented thresholds. Create durable intent in same database transaction as domain trigger; manual management-command sweep/dispatcher, no Celery/Redis dependency. Controlled synthetic staff recipients configured outside public APIs. Django owns outbox/retries; Node provides idempotent mock receipt only, not real SMS/email.

decisions.title: Reminder due time and late bookings
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: due_at=slot.starts_at−24h; approved scheduler cadence must make normal bookings send no later than due_at. For booking with less than 24h lead: immediate best-effort mock, tagged late_booking; explicitly NOT satisfaction of the ≥24h criterion. At exactly 24h, schedule immediately. Canceled/changed appointments invalidate old pending intent and deduplication prevents stale delivery.

decisions.title: Reporting sources and dates
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: Asia/Kolkata local from/to dates inclusive, translated to UTC half-open [from 00:00, day_after_to 00:00). Missing/reversed dates invalid. Stock summary current; pending requests=SUBMITTED; upcoming camps=ACTIVE starts_at>=now. Donation source is BloodUnit collection records, distinct donor_id+collection_date events plus separately labelled unit counts (limitation: distinct same-day donations indistinguishable); issue source IssueRecord; wastage explicit InventoryDisposition(DISCARDED) or computed expiry event once per unit, not both. Never call inventory units distinct donor donations without this definition approved.

decisions.title: Performance and availability evidence
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED for approval: synthetic college demo workload 500 donor profiles/500 units, 5 concurrent clients, 60s steady interval after warm-up; record environment and p95 ≤2s. This is a suggested test protocol, NOT measured evidence or an SRS rewrite. BB-03 observation window/exclusions still need actual approval and measurement.

decisions.title: Inventory collection and donor history
decisions.proposal: PROPOSED: recording a unit requires current ELIGIBLE donor, group derived/checked against profile. Update a confirmed last-donation source once per approved collection event; multiple components from same collection must not double-count or invalidate each other. Agree collection-event identifier/record before implementing this linkage; BB-13 may not invent a second donor-health schema.
